name: Planned Parenthood
description: Planned Parenthood offers sexual and reproductive health care at health centers across California and by telehealth, for patients with private insurance, Medi-Cal, or no insurance.
fullDescription: Planned Parenthood offers sexual and reproductive health care at health centers across California and by telehealth, for patients with private insurance, Medi-Cal, or no insurance.
whatTheyOffer:
- Birth control and contraception counseling
- STI testing and treatment
- HIV testing
- Cancer screenings (breast, cervical)
- Pregnancy testing and options counseling
- Abortion services
- Gender-affirming care, including hormone therapy
- Vasectomies, menopause services, and wellness exams
- Telehealth visits
howToGetIt: Find your nearest health center online or call 1-800-230-PLAN. Appointments recommended. Many centers accept Medi-Cal and Family PACT and offer sliding scale fees if you qualify.
keywords: Planned Parenthood, birth control, STI testing, HIV testing, cancer screening, pregnancy test, abortion, gender-affirming care, telehealth, Family PACT
